verses.1: As a healer for Israel, I will reveal the evils and sorrows of Sodom. For they have acted deceitfully and stolen. A wicked man will come upon them in their wilderness.
verses.2: And when they said all their evil things to each other, I remember now their actions against them. They were against my face.
verses.3: In their sorrow, the king shall rejoice; and in their weakness, the ministers will serve.
verses.4: They all seem like a bunch of worthless things, like a broken pipe from a forest. They’re just discarded objects from the city, left to rot until they’re completely destroyed.
verses.5: On the day of our king, the bees began to swarm. Their hands moved towards the bees.
verses.6: For they brought the lamp to their hearts during the night. All night long, they slept soundly. But in the morning, it became like fire that burns brightly.
verses.7: They all burned like torches, and they ate their own judgments. All their kings fell; no one could find them anymore.
verses.8: In other nations, it will be destroyed. Ephraim will be ruined; it will be in a state of destruction without any hope of recovery.
verses.9: They ate the foreign man’s flesh, and he didn’t even know that he had been bitten by a foreign creature. He simply didn’t realize it at all.
verses.10: And Gohon-Israel answered him, but they did not return to the LORD their God. They also did not ask for his help in any of these situations.
verses.11: And Ephraim became like a flower that blooms in spring. There was no heart among the people of Egypt. They called out for Assyria to come and help them.
verses.12: When Ephron went away, they set up a fence around it, like a rainbow in the sky. Then they heard their footsteps as they left.
verses.13: Oh, they are wretched! They have gone away from me. They have sinned against me. And I will forgive them. But those who spoke against me were liars.
verses.14: And they did not cry out to me with their hearts, because they were lying on their beds, on the ground. They were trapped and unable to escape.
verses.15: And I will remove their strength and weakness. They will be considered evil to me.
verses.16: They will not be able to rise up again. They will fall like pieces of trash. Their limbs will fall from their bodies in anger at being turned into objects of ridicule in Egypt.
